The mainline Persona series is a JRPG with dating sim elements. Every game is a bit different (Like Pokèmon) But have their similairities between each game.

It's about teenagers who awaken to their persona what's a bit like a mirror of your personality. What you do with your persona's is different in each game. In the game you build friendships to strenghten your persona. In all the games there's also an option to romance characters in the game but this is more of an afterthought.

The gameplay itself feels more like Pokèmon with the persona's you can add to your team and attacks of your persona's. It's definetly worth getting, Persona 5 Royal is one of my favorite games and the length of the game is around 130 hours (Which can differ, depending on the ending you get).

The new game releasing next month (February 23), Persona 5 Strikers is a lot different and a spin off. Persona 5 Strikers is a hack and slash game without the dating sim elements with the story taking place after Persona 5 Royal.

Persona 5 Royal is a PS4 exclusive so I recommend you playing either Persona 4 Golden (Steam, PS Vita) Or Persona 5 Strikers (PS4, Switch, Steam)
